title: Great Experience with Amazing Art and Leisurely time at the Beach! Highly Recommended!
text: Great Experience! Noelia, my Guide, was so knowledgeable and captured the essence of Dali, the context behind his art, the relationships and how important they were as they showed up in his art. Noelia is lively, personable and friendly. It is a pleasure to explore and learn with her. Our leisurely time at Costa Brava, eating lunch in a restaurant on the shore was a peaceful and lovely way to end the day.
author: YSTcruiser

title: Amazing Dalí and Costa Brava tour!
text: My kids (15 and 13 yo) and I had an amazing tour with Noelia! She picked us up on time and was a safe driver. It was almost like a private tour as it was just us. She was very knowledgable of Dalí’s life. We definitely would not have had the same experience had we gone by ourselves. Her explanation of the paintings was phenomenal. She included my kids in discussions as well. Costa Brava was equally wonderful. We had a nice lunch and time to relax and take in the beauty of the Coast and Mediterranean waters. title: Amazing guide
text:
Our visit to the Dalí Museum and Costa Brava was an unforgettable experience, and a huge part of that was thanks to our wonderful guide.

Noeli was incredibly knowledgeable, passionate, and genuinely engaging. You could immediately tell that she not only knew the history and facts, but truly understood the world of Salvador Dalí and Catalonia. She shared fascinating details and stories that made the museum come alive and helped us see Dalí’s work from a completely different perspective.

title: Marcelo is the best
text: If I could give Marcelo 10 stars I would.   He was so kind and knowledgeable  about Dali’s art and life. He gave us just the right amount of info and had fun stories.  If you are a fan of Dali, you should take this tour. You will have a better appreciation for his art and thought process.
